separation_policy: linear-program separation diagnostic; withhold ordinary ML estimates and tests for complete/quasi separation; no penalized fallback
reference_distribution: equal-weight mixture of the two empirical matching distributions, restricted to common supported bins

purification.removal_rule: cumulative union of within-form omnibus BH-screened items; ANC_14 always excluded; no re-entry

rest_score: prorated credit: matching-set size times observed correct proportion; no credit imputation for unrelated omissions
stage_boundary: Stage 6 only; no linking/equating, classification consistency, standard setting, cut validation, final certification decisions or operational item changes
